historicalCorrection.reason: Restore exact frozen legacy governance and tracker snapshots after the sweep; hash-bound old source strings are historical evidence, while all active consumers use canonical paths.

referenceIntegration.definition: Changed or new consumer/evidence files with added canonical-state paths or canonical path/discovery helper references relative to the frozen base. Excludes holding destinations and migration accounting inputs. Counts are changed lines, not literal occurrences.

artifactNote: Initial sweep counters remain the observation of that sweep. finalLiteralReferenceSweep subtracts nine deliberately restored immutable historical occurrences. referenceIntegration records the final consumer file census.

codeHoldingCorrection.reason: A1 was falsified by canonical source-backed civic data embedded in TypeScript. The exact same session base is reclassified; no later acquisition expanded scope.

moves.holdingSelector: MEASURE_SUMMARIES: eleven sourced Arizona measure summaries
NOTICE_SUMMARIES: one source-hash-bound TUSD notice summary
BODY_BLURBS and DIVISION_BODY_BLURBS: three sourced descriptions
AZ_CAWCD_ROSTERS: one sourced body, fifteen current members
INSITE_TENANTS: one acquired Mesa venue row; Pima venue rows derive from the separately held Legistar corpus
LEGISTAR_CLIENTS: two acquired Pima venue rows; adapter configuration stays in code

combinedLiteralSweeps.definition: Sum of applied literal replacements across the two recorded sweeps, excluding the three restored historical files. Repeated edits count as applied replacements; this is not a count of distinct final strings.
